svg.title: charuco_a4_12mm_print
svg.text: charuco_a4_12mm_print: ChArUco 20 x 14 squares of 12 mm, markers 9 mm, DICT_5X5_1000, legacy_pattern=False, board 240 x 168 mm
Print at 100 % (no fit-to-page). Check the scale with a caliper between SAME-SIDE edges (e.g. left edges of the first and last columns: 228 mm),
not the outer extent: printers enlarge black areas. Generated 2026-11-18 by metrogram target-svg.
